svg.text: PEF: keys split into superblocks (6400 keys each) → DP picks chunk boundaries within → per-chunk codec by min-bitsize
6400 keys → one DP call → 3 chunks shown

g.text: A (sparse): n=6, lastRel=199, ℓ=5 → 44 bits ⟪vs bitmap 200⟫
C (mid): n=4, lastRel=18, ℓ=2 → 18 bits ⟪vs bitmap 19, EF wins by 1⟫
Low bits (5 bits × 6 keys → 30 bits in p.lowBits)
High bits (unary, written into shared rsdic)
1 = bucket header, 0 = key in current bucket, $ = sentinel
Select1(b) on rs → bucket range → linear/binary
scan low-bits (≤128 keys → linear, else binary)
EF cost=25 bits vs bitmap cost=15 bits → bitmap wins
Dense bit-vector (15 bits in shared rsdic)
1 = key present at that relative position, 0 = absent
Stored alongside Chunk A's high bits in p.rs:
┌── EF high-bits (Chunk A) ──┬── BM bits (Chunk B) ──┐
